name: Pacman packages
description: Installs a list of system packages with pacman from the repositories the Arch Linux image already configures, as part of a full system upgrade.

packages.description: Comma-separated packages to install: a name, a provided name, or a group, optionally with a version constraint (name>=version) and optionally qualified with one of the image's repositories (repository/name). Whitespace around entries and empty entries are ignored; an empty list installs nothing, and a non-empty list also upgrades the whole system.

cleanup.description: Remove all managed caches, package files only, or skip feature cleanup. Native retention remains independent.

parallelDownloads.description: Upper bound of simultaneous package downloads, 1 to 20, or empty to inherit image settings; applies only to this invocation.
